title: Visible dark diff connectors
reference_disclaimer: This is a new immutable batch from repair commit 8b1108cc957225ef56402870daf2a9975feba8b6 and freshly generated image/fact bytes. It directly addresses the validated v004 rejection, 'The arrows look good now but the dark mode mode swoosh connectors are too hard to see except for the selected one.' No v003 or v004 decision carries forward. Judge the selected and unselected center-gutter connectors in Dark and High-contrast Dark first, then confirm the arrows, compact row, and diff remain coherent in both light profiles. The captures use Qt 6.11.1 offscreen QFusionStyle at device pixel ratio 1; native platform-specific artwork, issue closure, RFC closeout, release readiness, and deferred Linux/Windows work are outside this batch.

subjects.display_name: Are selected and unselected diff connectors now clear in dark modes?
subjects.description: Ordinary center-gutter connectors now use a palette-derived neutral stroke that stays visible on dark surfaces. The selected connector retains its highlighted fill and gains a contrasting edge. Review Dark and High-contrast Dark first; the compact toolbar, readable arrows, connector geometry, endpoints, and two-pane comparison are otherwise unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Unselected swoosh connectors are immediately visible in Dark
Unselected swoosh connectors are immediately visible in High-contrast Dark
The selected connector remains clearly distinguishable from the unselected connectors
The compact navigation arrows remain readable and recognizable in both dark profiles
Connector endpoints, one-row layout, and the focused two-pane diff remain coherent in all four profiles
known_concerns: These captures use offscreen QFusionStyle and judge the deterministic appearance profiles, not every native operating-system style.

The composed capture measures actual map pixels and contrast. Selected/unselected automation requires distinct dominant pixels, while this attended decision remains the perceptual check that the two states are clearly distinguishable.
The v003 and v004 rejections remain immutable evidence. Accepting this subject approves only the repaired connector criterion in these exact v005 bytes.

audit_verdict.note: The exact six-test selector passed 6/6. Actual unselected connector pixels measure 5.33:1 median contrast in Dark and 6.57:1 in High-contrast Dark, with 840/1008 samples at or above 3:1 in each profile. Selected connectors contribute 250 above-floor edge pixels and remain raster-distinct. Independent read-only closeout review found no blocker and confirmed that v004 would fail the new actual-raster gate.
